lines.text: In here is our bedroom. When we moved last Dec, we got a King size mattress and a weighted blanket. I still don’t actually sleep very well.
We thought about getting a bed frame, but ‘what are bedframes for’? And actually that’s a question for the show.
And in the corner - yes - that’s a door directly to the stairwell outside for fire reasons I assume. It’s a glass door with cheap rental blinds and there’s a light that’s always on out there.
It also doesn’t block spiders either, and this is the Pacific North West, so we have the door taped shut. But hey, we’ve been spider free for over two months.
